name: tiger_reactzyme_reaction_similarity_baseline_contract_v1

authoritative_external_baseline.name: TIGER
authoritative_external_baseline.reason_selected: TIGER directly evaluates bidirectional retrieval on the official ReactZyme reaction-similarity split, where test reactions are absent from training, and materially outperforms ReactZyme and CLIPZyme on that task. Executability alone is not grounds to choose a weaker baseline.

executable_reference_not_baseline.name: CLIPZyme
executable_reference_not_baseline.allowed_role: CLIPZyme is now the formal reproducible reaction-novel baseline; TIGER remains methodology/literature context only.

official_split.native_support_note: ReactZyme/TIGER construct the binary label matrix from unique test sequences and unique test reactions; duplicate source rows therefore yield 14,689 unique positive matrix cells from 14,692 source rows.
official_split.reaction_novel_claim: The official reaction-similarity test reactions are entirely absent from reaction-similarity training.

benchmark_reveal_state.prior_use: The official reaction-similarity membership was previously projected into broad Rhea double-cold evaluations.

metric_semantics.Hit@K: fraction of queries with at least one positive in the top K, matching ReactZyme top_acc2 semantics
metric_semantics.paper_MRR: ReactZyme-family mean over reciprocal ranks of every positive item per query, then mean over queries; this is not best-positive standard MRR and is represented locally as author_avg_positive_rr

catalyst_alignment_recipe.recipe_origin: Exact DualTowerNative recipe already frozen before this alignment in train_enzgfm_native_same_support_v1.py.
catalyst_alignment_recipe.reaction_representation: Native reaction molecule-bag Morgan radius-2 fpSize=2048; mean and max pooling concatenated to 4096d; author identity normalization replaces '*' by carbon and does not reorder components.

protein_feature_support.missing_train_policy: Do not drop the association. Extract exactly one overlay embedding with the same frozen EnzGFM-650M model/tokenizer/truncation/pooling semantics; overlay scope is determined from training-input identity only and never from test performance.

allowed_adaptation: the one train-only EnzGFM-650M overlay embedding required to preserve official training support
metric wrapper that explicitly preserves ReactZyme/TIGER metric semantics
forbidden_adaptation: mixing TIGER metrics with a weaker baseline to improve the apparent delta
calling paper MRR standard best-positive MRR
using this revealed native split as promotion evidence
